correctness.rationale: The imported classification and Proposition 4.2 apply at n≥5. In a permissible pair, t restricts to an involution on its image and all off-image vertices are leaves. Each e-fibre has one distinguished root star, arbitrary other root stars, and arbitrary two-cycles decorated by an unordered pair of leaf counts; the latter give floor(j/2) types at size j. This gives APQ, with AP exactly the no-two-cycle case, and taking multisets of fibres implements simultaneous relabelling. A rank-three square root of t must transpose two non-distinguished t-roots in an e-fibre. Conversely choose such a transposition on the roots, fixing the others, and compose it with t to obtain u. The multiplication table shows that a product of image-rank≥3 maps becomes rank two only by replacing a rank-three parameter u by u², up to relabelling: odd-type factors preserve the right parameter, even-type factors square it, and singular t collapses the image to rank one. Iterating the table cannot undo a rank drop. A double transposition fixing one point, with e constant there, supplies the even-type factor at every n≥5. Thus essential rank-two fibres have at most one additional root star; exactly the partition subfamily t=e must be removed. Independently multiplied truncated geometric factors through degree 12; reproduced all eight displayed ranks, beginning with orbit counts 15 and 17 at n=5. Inspected checker.py and its recorded output without executing them; neither finite computation establishes the quantified theorem. The original classification is due to Schein–Teclezghi, as cited by Gould–Grau–Johnson, Theorem 2.1.
